summary: Preinstall beacon exfiltrates installer username and hostname to OAST endpoint
details: The package's preinstall.js runs automatically on npm install and transmits the installer's identity to an attacker-controlled out-of-band domain. It reads USER/USERNAME from process.env and calls os.hostname(), then performs a DNS lookup and an HTTPS GET to https://4otph6fase1x2won0hrfzul2wt2qqge5.oastify.com/depconf/<pkg>/<username>/<hostname>. The oastify.com host is a Burp Collaborator OAST endpoint operated by a third party, not by the installer or the @wbnr scope. The package is framed as a dependency-confusion proof-of-concept, but the beacon fires unconditionally on install without opt-in, and the package name plus a 99.1.0 version bump are consistent with a dependency-confusion attempt against an internal @wbnr namespace.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
